import io
import os
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, 'src')
import dotenv

def test_crlf_update_and_remove(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / '.env'
    p.write_bytes(b'A=old\r\nB=keep\r\n')
    dotenv.set_key(p, 'A', 'new')
    assert p.read_bytes() == b"A='new'\r\nB=keep\r\n"
    dotenv.unset_key(p, 'A')
    assert p.read_bytes() == b'B=keep\r\n'

def test_lf_update_and_remove(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / '.env'
    p.write_bytes(b'A=old\nB=keep\n')
    dotenv.set_key(p, 'A', 'new')
    assert p.read_bytes() == b"A='new'\nB=keep\n"
    dotenv.unset_key(p, 'A')
    assert p.read_bytes() == b'B=keep\n'

def test_mixed_uses_first(tmp_path):

    p.write_bytes(b'A=old\r\nB=keep\n')

    assert p.read_bytes() == b"A=old\r\nB=keep\nC='x'\r\n"

def test_empty_file_defaults_lf(tmp_path):

def test_get_key_interpolate_false(tmp_path):

    assert dotenv.get_key(p, 'A') == 'world'

def test_dotenv_values_override(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    p = tmp_path / '.env'
    p.write_bytes(b'A=${B}\nB=file\n')

    assert dotenv.dotenv_values(p, override=True)['A'] == 'file'
    assert dotenv.dotenv_values(p, override=False)['A'] == 'env'
    assert 'B' not in os.environ or os.environ.get('B') == 'env'
